At the end of the spell's duration, Death Prophet is healed in proportion to the damage dealt. Deals 50% damage to buildings. Lasts %abilityduration% seconds.
Over time, the banshee remnants of her previous lives return to haunt the present.
Radius represents the area in which the spirits will acquire targets around Death Prophet.
Spirit damage isn't reduced by damage block abilities.
Whenever an enemy is affected by Death Prophet's spells or when she attacks an enemy, a ghost will fly out and hit the enemy for an increased bonus of its usual damage then return to her with life.

tokens.npc_dota_hero_death_prophet_bio:
Krobelus was a Death Prophet--which is one way of saying she told fortunes for the wealthiest of those who wished to look beyond the veil. But after years of inquiring on behalf of others, she began to seek clues on her own fate. When death refused to yield its secrets, she tried to buy them with her life. But the ultimate price proved insufficient.

Death disgorged her again and again, always holding back its deepest mysteries. Her jealousy grew. Others could die for eternity--why not she? Why must she alone be cast back on the shores of life with such tiresome regularity? Why was she not worthy of the one thing all other living creatures took for granted? Still, she would not be discouraged.

Each time she returned from the grave, she brought a bit of death back with her. Wraiths followed her like fragments of her shattered soul; her blood grew thin and ectoplasmic; the feasting creatures of twilight took her for their kin.. She gave a little of her life with every demise, and it began to seem as if her end was in sight. With her dedication to death redoubled, and no client other than herself, Krobelus threw herself ever more fervently into death's abyss, intent on fulfilling the one prophecy that eluded her: That someday the Death Prophet would return from death no more.
tokens.npc_dota_hero_death_prophet_hype: When she unleashes her army of ghosts, Death Prophet excels at demolishing enemies and their defenses alike. Leading her team's forces toward the enemy base with wave after damaging wave from her swarm, her onslaught can seem unstoppable.

fields.name: mechanics
fields.value:
* [[File:Dota2 Death Prophet Spirits icon.png|21px|Spirit Properties]]
** Spawns each spirit in {{#var:Exorcism basic1}}-second intervals.
*** The first spirit spawns immediately upon cast, subsequent spirits are released within {{calc|(v1-1)*{{#var:Exorcism basic1}}|v1={{#var:Exorcism value1}}}} ({{Symbol|bonus t4l}} {{ValueColor||{{calc|(v1-1)*{{#var:Exorcism basic1}}|v1={{#var:Exorcism value1 tal}}}}|25tal}}) seconds.
** {{Symbol|Affect|Self}}
*** Spirits exceeding {{Code|< 2000-radius}} of Krobelus disappear, and respawns from her in the same intervals.
*** Recasting the ability causes the previous cast to end, the spirits returns to Krobelus, and {{M|heals}} her.
** Have the following unit properties:
*** Uncontrollable.
*** Neither intercepts not interacts with any abilities.
*** Does not block {{M|neutral creep}} camps.
*** Can only {{M|Turn Rate|text=turn}} by moving in a ≈150-radius arc.
** {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}}
*** Roam around and automatically attack nearby enemy units within its acqusition radius, centered around Krobelus, with the following attack priority sequence:
**** {{hi|Death Prophet}} The Current Attacked {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}} Enemy Unit {{to}} {{hi|Death Prophet}} {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}} Nearest Enemy Unit {{Symbol|Affect|Enemy}} {{to}} [[File:Dota2 Death Prophet Spirits icon.png|21px|Spirits]] Acquisition Radius
*** Upon attacking a valid enemy unit, the spirit does not change its target except for the following conditions:
**** {{hi|Death Prophet}} The Current Attacked Enemy Unit
**** Upon the targeted enemy unit's {{M|death}}.
**** The enemy unit is {{Code|≥ {{#expr:{{#var:Exorcism type1 value1}}+{{#var:Exorcism type1 value2}}}}-distance}} from Death Prophet.
** {{Symbol|Projectile|Travel}}
*** The ongoing chase cannot be canceled, until the spirit reaches its targeted enemy unit.
*** Deals {{M|physical}} {{M|spell damage}} on the targeted valid enemy unit upon reaching them.
*** After dealing damage, the spirits need to return to Death Prophet before being able to attack again.
** [[File:Dota2 Heal icon allmode.png|21px|Heal Properties]]
*** Collectively [[heal]]s Death Prophet for the full value regardless of damage instance value, upon returning once the ability duration expires.
*** {{cf|expr}} {{Code|Heal[[Wikipedia:Arithmetic mean|MeanValue]] {{=}} ({{#var:Exorcism type1 value4}} + {{#var:Exorcism type1 value5}}) / 2 × [[Heal]]Factor × {{#var:Exorcism value1}} OR {{ValueColor||{{#var:Exorcism value1 tal}}|25tal|x}}}}

* Does not affect the following units:
** {{M|Invisible}} units.
** Hit count {{M|ward-type units}}.
** {{U|Undying Zombie}}.
** Neither damages {{M|Attack Immunity|text=attack immune}} nor {{M|invulnerable}} units, but will continue to deal damage to the target if it turns invulnerable or attack immune after being acquired as a target.

* Affects the following units:
** {{A|Techies|Proximity Mines}}
** {{M|Outposts}}, despite not being attackable.
** {{M|Couriers}} have the lowest target priority.

* {{cf|aghnotes}} The passive Exorcism spirit spawn only work specifically with the following abilities:
** {{A|Death Prophet|Crypt Swarm}}
** {{A|Death Prophet|Silence}}
** {{A|Death Prophet|Spirit Siphon}}
** {{Symbol|bonus agh}} [[File:Dota2 Death Prophet Spirits icon.png|21px|Spirit Properties]] Has the same Exorcism spirit properties, and has a max {{ValueColor||{{#var:Exorcism type3 value2 agh}}|agh}}-second target chase duration.
*** Does not increase the {{M|physical}} {{M|spell damage}} of an active cast.

data.name: npc_dota_hero_death_prophet
data.bio_loc:
Krobelus was a Death Prophet--which is one way of saying she told fortunes for the wealthiest of those who wished to look beyond the veil. But after years of inquiring on behalf of others, she began to seek clues on her own fate. When death refused to yield its secrets, she tried to buy them with her life. But the ultimate price proved insufficient.

Death disgorged her again and again, always holding back its deepest mysteries. Her jealousy grew. Others could die for eternity--why not she? Why must she alone be cast back on the shores of life with such tiresome regularity? Why was she not worthy of the one thing all other living creatures took for granted? Still, she would not be discouraged.

Each time she returned from the grave, she brought a bit of death back with her. Wraiths followed her like fragments of her shattered soul; her blood grew thin and ectoplasmic; the feasting creatures of twilight took her for their kin.. She gave a little of her life with every demise, and it began to seem as if her end was in sight. With her dedication to death redoubled, and no client other than herself, Krobelus threw herself ever more fervently into death's abyss, intent on fulfilling the one prophecy that eluded her: That someday the Death Prophet would return from death no more.
data.hype_loc: When she unleashes her army of ghosts, Death Prophet excels at demolishing enemies and their defenses alike. Leading her team's forces toward the enemy base with wave after damaging wave from her swarm, her onslaught can seem unstoppable.

abilities.name: death_prophet_carrion_swarm
abilities.desc_loc: Sends a swarm of winged beasts to savage enemy units in front of Death Prophet.
abilities.lore_loc: Krobelus' many trips to the grave gather a flock of the damned.
notes_loc: Can hit units up to 1110 range away.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

abilities.name: death_prophet_silence
abilities.desc_loc: Fires a projectile that prevents enemy units in a target area from casting spells.
abilities.lore_loc: Peering into the veil of her opponent's demise, Krobelus sees a silent future.

abilities.name: death_prophet_spirit_siphon
abilities.desc_loc: Creates a spirit link between Death Prophet and an enemy unit, draining health from the enemy.
abilities.lore_loc: Krobelus willingly shows others the path she alone cannot follow.
notes_loc: Cannot cast multiple on same target.
abilities.shard_loc: Increases Spirit Siphon charges by %shard_bonus_charges% and causes enemies to be feared for %shard_fear_duration% seconds if they are siphoned for %shard_consecutive_siphon_duration% seconds consecutively.

abilities.name: death_prophet_witchcraft
abilities.desc_loc: Death Prophet's occult knowledge deepens with experience, gaining movement speed and spell cooldown reduction.

abilities.name: death_prophet_exorcism
abilities.desc_loc: Unleashes evil spirits to drain the life of nearby enemy units and structures. Spirits need to return back to Death Prophet in order to attack again. At the end of the spell's duration, Death Prophet is healed in proportion to the damage dealt. Deals 50% damage to buildings. Lasts %abilityduration% seconds.
abilities.lore_loc: Over time, the banshee remnants of her previous lives return to haunt the present.
notes_loc: Radius represents the area in which the spirits will acquire targets around Death Prophet.
Spirit damage isn't reduced by damage block abilities.
abilities.scepter_loc: Whenever an enemy is affected by Death Prophet's spells or when she attacks an enemy, a ghost will fly out and hit the enemy for an increased bonus of its usual damage then return to her with life.

talents.name: special_bonus_unique_death_prophet_exorcism_duration_on_kill
talents.name_loc: Deaths During Exorcism Extend Duration By +{s:bonus_duration_increase_per_kill}s

officialDataset.interpretation: Official website declarations, retained in full; not an assertion of complete engine verification.
